venues_capacity_check.name: venues_capacity_check
venues_capacity_check.value:
("venues"."capacity_min" IS NULL OR "venues"."capacity_min" > 0)
        AND ("venues"."capacity_max" IS NULL OR "venues"."capacity_max" > 0)
        AND ("venues"."capacity_min" IS NULL OR "venues"."capacity_max" IS NULL OR "venues"."capacity_max" >= "venues"."capacity_min")

inquiries_one_target_check.name: inquiries_one_target_check
inquiries_one_target_check.value: ("inquiries"."vendor_listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."venue_id" IS NULL) OR ("inquiries"."vendor_listing_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."venue_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_offer_consistency.name: messages_offer_consistency
messages_offer_consistency.value: ("messages"."offer_amount" IS NULL AND "messages"."offer_status" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."offer_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."offer_status" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."offer_amount" > 0)

bookings_one_target_check.name: bookings_one_target_check
bookings_one_target_check.value: ("bookings"."vendor_listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."venue_id" IS NULL) OR ("bookings"."vendor_listing_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."venue_id" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_paid_out_check.name: bookings_paid_out_check
bookings_paid_out_check.value: "bookings"."paid_out_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."payout_reference" IS NOT NULL
